{{Quote|Titroxinate was the pre-patent name for the weaponized agent we think was responsible for the rakghoul plague.|Welkins|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Welkins''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the war he served as an agent and was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], where he was tasked with investigating reports of the sale of the chemical [[Titroxinate]] on the planet's black market. He discovered the source of the chemical being sold was an old [[Taris ChemWorks Factory|ChemWorks Factory]] in the ruins of Taris, and he sent a group of Republic heroes on a mission to clear it out, recovering any Titroxinate they found their and bringing it back to him. The heroes succeeded in their mission for which he rewarded them individually.<ref name="TOR" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|The Empire could fashion it into a terrible weapon--turning our soldiers into monsters and setting them against us.|Welkins speaking about Titroxinate|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Welkins was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] alive during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a galaxy-spanning conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] following the [[Great Galactic War]]. During the war, Welkins served as part of the Republic's forces. He held the rank of agent and was assigned to the Republic-held [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] within the [[Taris system/Legends|Taris system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

The planet's huge [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] was at the time still under reconstruction as part of the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]] after the devastating [[Destruction of Taris|bombardment]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malak]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> as well as the effects of the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]]. While on the planet Welkins learned of the sale of a chemical known as [[Titroxinate]], which was believed to have partially caused the Rakghoul plague, on the world's black market. Investigating the sales he eventually discovered that the source of the chemical being used by the sellers was an ancient [[Taris ChemWorks Factory|ChemWorks Factory]], which was soon to collapse,<ref name="TORBO">{{TORcite|type=general|Burnoff|Taris}}</ref> but still contained canisters of Titroxinate.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
[[File:Titroxinate.png|thumb|left|One of the Titroxinate canisters in the ChemWorks]]
Stationed at [[Bomber command post|Waypoint Station Draay]], the closest Republic base to the factory, Welkins hoped to retrieve the chemicals from the factory and asked that a group of trusted Republic heroes, who were each pursuing their own mission on Taris, do so while they were there. The group, which consisted of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as [[Hotshot/Legends|Hotshot]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Hero of Tython]], the Jedi consular who would become [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] and the [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|leader]] of [[Havoc Squad]] at the time, the four traveled to the factory where they fought numerous [[Rakghoul]]s and successfully recovered the Titroxinate stored there. Upon their return the heroes brought the canisters of chemicals back to Welkins, for which he thanked them and rewarded each with a piece of equipment and [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Welkins was a tanned Human male with brown hair and eyes who spoke fluent [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]]. He was overweight for a Human despite his military profession and wore [[Armor/Legends|armor]] while on Taris to defend himself from the planet's many dangerous inhabitants.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Welkins first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He appears on the Republic version of Taris and gives players the quest ''Toxic heirlooms'' in Waypoint station Draay.<ref name="TOR" />
